Tradeify Overview
Tradeify is a US-based futures prop firm offering three account types: Growth Evaluation, Select Evaluation, and Lightning Funded. All accounts use End-of-Day (EOD) trailing drawdowns with one-time purchases (no recurring subscriptions). Maximum funding up to $750K with 90% profit split on Sim Funded accounts.

Program snapshot: Three account types — Growth Evaluation (1-day pass possible, has Daily Loss Limit), Select Evaluation (3-day minimum, no DLL during eval, choose Flex or Daily payout policy after passing), and Lightning Funded (instant funding, no evaluation, no resets). All sizes: 25K / 50K / 100K / 150K. All accounts are one-time purchases (no subscriptions since "Tradeify 3.0"). All drawdowns are End-of-Day trailing. Sim Funded profit split 90/10; Elite Live 80/20. Note: legacy "Advanced" accounts are discontinued (they had a $125 activation fee); "Select" replaced the older lineup. Tradeify Crypto (tradeifycrypto.com) is a separate product with separate rules.

1. Accounts & Pricing
Sources: https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/14369021-tradeify-pricing-reference · https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/10468265-which-plan-is-right-for-you · https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/13252431-select-vs-growth-choosing-your-evaluation-type · https://tradeify.co

Q: What account types does Tradeify offer?
Three types, each in 25K, 50K, 100K, and 150K sizes:
•Growth Evaluation — pass to get funded; has a Daily Loss Limit (soft breach ); NO consistency rule during evaluation; can pass in 1 day; funded stage has a 35% consistency rule; fixed payout policy.
•Select Evaluation — pass to get funded; NO Daily Loss Limit during evaluation; 40% consistency rule during evaluation only (minimum 3 trading days); after passing you choose a permanent payout policy: Select Flex (5-day) or Select Daily.
•Lightning Funded — instant funding, no evaluation; progressive consistency rule for payouts (20% → 25% → 30%); no resets available.

Q: How much do Tradeify accounts cost?
One-time purchases (no recurring billing). List prices from the official Pricing Reference:
•Growth Evaluation: 25K = $99 · 50K = $145 · 100K = $255 · 150K = $369. Reset fees: $60 / $95 / $155 / $215.
•Select Evaluation: 25K = $109 · 50K = $165 · 100K = $265 · 150K = $369. Reset fees: $60 / $95 / $169 / $239.
•Lightning Funded: 25K = $345 · 50K = $492 · 100K = $660 · 150K = $796. No resets — buy a new account if failed.
Promo codes may lower these (e.g., the tradeify.co homepage in July 2026 showed accounts at $251 with code "JULY"). Note: the older "Which Plan is Right for You?" article shows outdated ranges (Select $95‒$215, Growth $99‒$349, Lightning $349‒$729) — the Pricing Reference table above is the current canonical source.

Q: Are Tradeify accounts subscriptions or one-time purchases?
All accounts are one-time purchases — no recurring billing or monthly subscription. You pay once and trade until you pass (evaluations) or for the life of the account (Lightning). Subscriptions were eliminated in "Tradeify 3.0"; pre-3.0 subscriptions remain active only until the holder cancels.

Q: Is there a time limit to complete an evaluation?
No. Neither Growth nor Select evaluations have a time limit. The account stays active as long as you don't breach the trailing drawdown and you meet the minimum activity requirement (at least 1 trade per week).

Q: What is the maximum funding available?
Up to 5 simultaneous funded accounts; homepage advertises maximum funding of $750K (5 × $150K). Profit split 90% on Sim Funded accounts.

Q: Is there a multi-account/bundle discount?
Yes — a 5-account bundle with an automatic 5% discount, available only for Growth 25K, Growth 50K, Select 25K, and Select 50K (not 100K/150K, not Lightning). All 5 must be the same type and size, bought in one checkout via the "Bundle and save" option. It stacks with promo codes (e.g., 5× Select 25K = $545 → $517 after 5% → ~$310 with a 40% promo code). There is no 2/3/4-account bundle; any other quantity must be bought as separate full-price checkouts, and the discount is never applied retroactively.

Q: Are there purchase limits on evaluations?
•Select: maximum 15 Select evaluations purchased within any 30-day period; each Select evaluation can be reset up to 10 times within a 30-day period.
•Growth: no limit on the number of Growth evaluation accounts.
•Funded: maximum 5 active Sim Funded accounts at any time (per user AND per household).

Q: How many funded (Sim Funded) accounts can I have?
Maximum 5 Simulated Funded accounts at any time, in any combination of Growth, Select (Flex/Daily), and Lightning. The limit applies per household — all funded accounts of everyone in the same household count toward the 5. Failed/expired accounts don't count. You can pass unlimited evaluations and "bank" the passed accounts, activating them as funded slots open. There is also a daily activation limit: max 5 Growth Funded activations per day (resets every 24h UTC).

Q: Which plan should I choose (Select vs Growth vs Lightning)?
•Choose Growth to get funded fastest (pass in as little as 1 day, no consistency rule during eval) if you can respect a Daily Loss Limit; cheapest option.
•Choose Select for maximum intraday flexibility (no DLL during eval) and the ability to pick your funded payout policy (Flex or Daily) after passing; requires 3+ trading days due to the 40% consistency rule.
•Choose Lightning to skip the evaluation entirely (instant funding); higher price, progressive consistency rule for payouts, and no resets.

Q: What type of drawdown does Tradeify use — intraday or end-of-day?
All Tradeify accounts (evaluation, sim funded, and Elite Live) use End-of-Day (EOD) trailing max drawdown. The drawdown limit recalculates only at market close based on your end-of-day balance, trails your highest EOD balance (high-water mark), and only moves up, never down. Important: even though it only UPDATES at end of day, it is ENFORCED in real time — if your balance touches the drawdown floor intraday, the account fails immediately. Hitting the max trailing drawdown is a hard breach (permanent account failure).

Q: Can I pass an evaluation in one day?
Growth: yes — no consistency rule, so hitting the profit target in 1 day passes. Select: no — minimum 3 trading days because no single day may exceed 40% of total profit. There is no daily profit cap on either; e.g., on Select 50K three days of +$1,050 (total $3,150, each day 33%) passes.

Q: Do evaluation profits carry over to my funded account?
No. Your funded account starts at the base account size regardless of your evaluation ending balance (e.g., ending eval at $53,200 still starts funded at $50,000).

Q: How do I get funded after passing?
Activation is instant and free once objectives are met: go to your dashboard, find the account card, click "Activate Account." The dashboard updates during the daily reconciliation window (~5‒8 PM EST), so a pass late in the day may activate after that window. Activation is NOT automatic — you must click Activate. There is a set activation window after passing; if you don't activate within the allowed timeframe you may need to purchase a new evaluation. (Exact window length not published in the Help Center — confirm with support.)

Q: Are there activation fees?
No. Growth, Select, and Lightning have no activation fees. Only the discontinued legacy "Advanced" account had a $125 activation fee.

A simulated environment that mirrors live markets — trades are not placed with real capital, but profits pay real payouts (90/10 split). Seeing "Demo"/"Simulation" in Tradovate is expected and correct. Risk managers monitor performance; consistent performers may be transitioned to Elite Live (real capital).

Q: What are the Select Flex funded account parameters?
Maximum drawdown (EOD): $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500 (25K/50K/100K/150K). No Daily Loss Limit. No consistency rule. Starting contracts 1/2/3/3 minis, scaling to max 2/4/8/12 minis.

Q: What are the Select Daily funded account parameters?
Maximum drawdown (EOD): $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,500. Daily Loss Limit: $500 / $1,000 / $1,250 / $1,750. No consistency rule. Buffer required before payouts: $1,100 / $2,100 / $2,600 / $3,600. Same contract scaling as Flex.

Q: How does the Daily Loss Limit (DLL) work?
The DLL is a soft breach: hitting it pauses trading for the rest of the day (Liquidation-Only mode) but does NOT fail the account; you can trade again next session (after 6:00 PM ET). It resets every trading day. It applies to Growth, Lightning (50K+), and Select Daily funded accounts; Select Flex and 25K Lightning have no DLL. Never use the DLL as a stop loss — slippage past it can breach the Max Trailing Drawdown, which DOES fail the account.

Q: Does the DLL ever increase?
Yes. When the account reaches 6% profit (balance $26,500 / $53,000 / $106,000 / $159,000), the DLL increases to match the drawdown amount, effective the NEXT session: Growth → $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $5,000; Lightning → N/A / $2,000 / $4,000 / $5,250. Legacy accounts (purchased before Sep 12, 2025 8:00 AM EST): the DLL is completely REMOVED at 6% profit instead.

Q: What is the consistency rule?
No single day's profit (commissions excluded) may exceed a set % of your total profit for the period:
•Growth Sim Funded: 35% (for payout eligibility)
•Select Evaluation: 40% (evaluation phase only — NO consistency rule on Select funded accounts, Flex or Daily)
•Lightning Funded (bought after Sep 12, 2025 8:00 AM EST): 20% for payout 1, 25% for payout 2, 30% for payout 3+. Bought before that date: flat 20% for all payouts.
Formula: biggest EOD profit ÷ consistency % = total profit needed (e.g., $1,000 best day at 20% requires $5,000 total). Consistency resets after each approved payout. Exceeding it never fails the account — it only delays payout eligibility; keep adding profitable days to bring the % down. Losing days reduce total profit and therefore make your consistency % worse. Dashboard consistency updates in real time.

Q: How does contract scaling work on Select funded accounts?
Select funded accounts (both policies) start at reduced limits and scale by EOD equity, applied the next trading day, cumulative (never scales back down):
•25K: start 1 mini/10 micro → $1,500 equity: 2/20 (max)
•50K: start 2/20 → $1,500: 3/30 → $2,000: 4/40 (max)
•100K: start 3/30 → $1,500: 4/40 → $2,000: 5/50 → $3,000: 8/80 (max)
•150K: start 3/30 → $1,500: 4/40 → $2,000: 5/50 → $3,000: 8/80 → $4,500: 12/120 (max)
Growth and Lightning funded accounts have no scaling restrictions — full position limits from day one.

Q: What are the contract/position limits?
Standard maximums (post-Sep 12, 2025): 25K = 1 mini (10 micros), 50K = 4 minis (40 micros), 100K = 8 minis (80 micros), 150K = 12 minis (120 micros). 10 micros = 1 mini. Minis and micros MAY be held simultaneously as long as the combined position stays within the limit at the 10:1 ratio (and not in opposing directions — that's hedging).

Q: What happens if my funded account breaches?
A Max Trailing Drawdown breach terminates the funded account permanently — there is no reset for Sim Funded accounts (any type). To get funded again you must purchase and pass a new evaluation (or buy a new Lightning account).

Q: Is there an inactivity rule?
Yes. Every evaluation and funded account requires at least one trade per week (Monday‒Friday), per account. The trade can be as brief as 5 seconds. Tradeify emails a warning before acting; inactive accounts can be removed/deleted and cannot be reactivated.

4. Payouts
Sources: https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/11083796-growth-funded-account-payout-policy · https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/10495932-lightning-funded-account-payout-policy · https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/12853966-select-flex-and-select-daily-payout-policies · https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/12844518-rise-payouts-main-payout-method · https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/10495945-plane-payouts-an-alternative-payout-option · https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/12268494-common-faqs

Q: What is the profit split?
•Sim Funded (Growth, Select, Lightning ): 90% trader / 10% Tradeify, from the very first payout.
•Elite Live: 80% trader / 20% Tradeify.
•Legacy Live: original terms retained (90/10 on starting-balance withdrawals, 80/20 above it).

Q: How are payouts paid, and how fast?
Primary method: Rise (Riseworks) — after Tradeify approves a payout, funds hit your Rise wallet within 24‒48 hours; bank (ACH) withdrawal 1‒3 business days, crypto usually within hours. Alternative: Plane (bank-to-bank, up to 7 days; only offered if Rise is unavailable in your country or your Rise application is denied; ~1-week setup). PayPal is NOT supported. Requests submitted outside 
business hours (Mon‒Fri 8 AM‒5 PM EST, and federal holidays) may take up to 72 hours. Once submitted, a payout request cannot be edited or canceled. Once approved, funds are immediately deducted from the account.

Q: What are the Growth Funded payout rules?
All conditions required per request:
•35% consistency rule.
•5+ profitable trading days each showing profit above: $100 (25K) / $150 (50K) / $200 (100K) / $250 (150K). Day count resets after each payout.
•Minimum balance: $26,500 (25K) / $53,000 (50K) / $104,500 (100K) / $156,500 (150K) — must be maintained until approval. (Pre-Sep-12-2025 accounts: $52,100 / $103,600 / $155,100.)
•Minimum payout: $250 / $500 / $1,000 / $1,500 by size.
•Maximum per request (withdrawal caps): Payout 1: $1,000 / $1,500 / $2,000 / $2,500 · Payout 2: $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 · Payout 3: $1,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $4,000 · Payout 4+: $1,000 / $3,000 / $4,000 / $5,000. (Legacy pre-Sep-12 accounts use the older 6-tier table; after the 6th payout, up to $25,000 per request.)

Q: What are the Lightning Funded payout rules?
•Consistency: 20% (payout 1) → 25% (payout 2) → 30% (payout 3+) for accounts bought after Sep 12, 2025; flat 20% for older accounts.
•No minimum trading days — request as soon as profit goal + consistency are met.
•Profit goals (fresh profit required each cycle; leftover profit does not carry over): Payout 1: $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 (25K/50K/100K/150K); Payout 2+: $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $4,500. (Pre-Sep-12 accounts: payout 3+ goals $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000.)
•Minimum payout $1,000. Maximum per request: Payouts 1‒3: $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000; Payout 4+: $1,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $3,500. 25K accounts: fixed $1,000 every payout.
•The profit goal is what you must EARN; the cap is what you may WITHDRAW (e.g., 150K payout 1: earn $9,000, withdraw max $3,000 — the rest stays in the account).

Q: What are the Select Flex payout rules?
•Frequency: every 5 winning days (winning day = at least $100 / $150 / $200 / $250 profit by size).
•Withdraw up to 50% of total profits (current balance minus starting balance), capped per payout at $1,250 / $3,000 / $4,000 / $5,000.
•No minimum balance requirement — payout allowed after 5 winning days regardless of balance.
•All payouts after the first require positive net profit in the current payout cycle (losses must be earned back first).
•The 50% is computed on TOTAL profit (balance − starting balance), not just current-cycle profit.

Q: What are the Select Daily payout rules?
•Daily payout eligibility once balance exceeds the buffer: $1,100 / $2,100 / $2,600 / $3,600 (fixed for account life; withdrawals can never dip into the buffer).
•Daily Continuity Rule: request up to 2× the profit earned since your last payout, capped at $600 / $1,000 / $1,500 / $2,500 per payout. Minimum payout $250 (so you need ≥$125 cycle profit). Profit resets to zero after each payout.
•Must have positive net profit for the cycle; 24-hour processing guarantee.

Q: If I lose money after a payout, can I still request the next one?
No — on both Select Flex and Select Daily you must trade back to net-positive for the current cycle first (earn back the loss plus at least $1). On Lightning, profit goals reset each cycle and require fresh profit. On Growth, all payout conditions (consistency, 5 profitable days, min balance) must be re-met.

Q: Can I keep trading after submitting a payout request?
Yes, but if you fail the account or fall below the payout thresholds before the request is processed, the payout is denied. Cycle accounting: profits made before approval count toward the CURRENT cycle; profits after approval in the same session count toward the NEXT cycle. Best practice: wait for a new session (6 PM ET) after approval before trading. Daily reconciliation runs ~6:00‒8:00 PM EST.

Q: Is there a minimum number of trading days before the first payout?
Account-type dependent: Lightning and Select Daily have no minimum-day requirement; Growth and Select Flex require 5 profitable/winning days per cycle. The old blanket 7-day requirement has been removed.

Q: Who issues tax forms for payouts?
Rise (the payout processor) issues 1099s — not Tradeify. Purchase receipts/invoices for your Tradeify expenses can be downloaded at app-f.tradeify.co/dashboard/billing → Transactions → View Transaction → Download.

Q: Can payouts go to a company/LLC?
Yes — keep your single personal Tradeify account and complete KYB (Know Your Business) with the payment processor at payout time. Required: incorporation documents, proof of ownership (e.g., Operating Agreement for US LLCs), and government ID for every ≥25% owner. Tradeify account email must match the payment-processor email. Payouts otherwise must go to an account in your own name.

5. Elite Live Program (and Legacy Live)

Q: How do I qualify for a real-money (Elite Live ) account?
Minimum thresholds for consideration (not automatic): 3 payouts on a single account, OR 10 total payouts across all plan types since your last live transition (or since first purchase). Tradeify selects traders holistically (consistency, risk management); most traders are NOT moved live immediately at the threshold — Tradeify's team reaches out when selected. Applies to all plans (Select, Growth, Lightning). Conflict note: an older FAQ line says "typically after 4-5 payouts" and the Select-vs-Growth article says "after 5 successful payouts" — the Elite Program article's 3-on-one-account / 10-total thresholds are the current canonical rule.

Q: Is the Elite Live transition optional?
No. Once selected, transition is mandatory — you cannot decline and keep Sim Funded accounts. On transition, ALL Sim Funded and evaluation accounts close; every funded account that has received at least one payout converts to its own Elite Live account (up to 5 live accounts). Accounts without a payout do not transition. Progress after your last successful payout is not carried into the transition.

Q: What are the Elite Accelerator Reward Pools?
Each live account carries a Performance Reward Pool on top of trading profits: $2,000 (25K) / $4,000 (50K) / $8,000 (100K) / $12,000 (150K) per account. Select-plan traders who kept a sim consistency score below 40% AND never exceeded 75% of max drawdown get a 1.5× multiplier ($3,000 / $6,000 / $12,000 / $18,000). Monthly unlock requires 5 profitable days of ≥$250 each AND month-end profit above $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500; maximum monthly reward up to $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500 per account. Breached accounts forfeit the remaining pool. Rewards can be cashed out, added to the account as extra drawdown, or saved. Payouts (rewards and profits) at 80/20.

Q: What happens if I fail an Elite Live account?
A cool-off period of up to 4 weeks (depending on performance), after which you may purchase a new evaluation and re-enter the program. Payouts from previous sim accounts do NOT count toward new Elite qualification.

Q: Can I hold Sim and Live accounts at the same time?
No. Sim Funded and Live accounts cannot be active simultaneously (different data subscriptions) — this restriction applies to the whole household. With an active Live account you cannot purchase or activate new evaluations or sim accounts.

Q: What is Elite-Only Mode?
Tradeify may designate certain traders Elite-Only based on performance/risk assessment. Elite-Only traders can only trade the Select plan, and passing a Select evaluation issues a Live account directly (skipping the sim funded phase). Traders are notified directly if placed in this mode.

Q: What is the Legacy Live program?
For accounts purchased before Dec 3, 2025 (trader's choice of legacy vs Elite). Legacy terms: single Live account after 4 payouts on the same sim account; sim balance carried forward = lesser of remaining balance or 10% of account size ($2,500/$5,000/$10,000/$15,000); $100,000 lifetime cap on combined sim payouts + live transition; automatic move to Live at $80,000 total payouts; starting balance withdrawable after 20 trading days of ≥$200/day at 90/10; profits above starting balance at 80/20, daily requests, $250 minimum; balance-based scaling table (DLL from $2,000 up to $100,000; contracts up to 50; swing trading allowed from $100K balance with contract limits); SPIFF bonuses (weekly up to $1,000, monthly up to $4,500, quarterly up to $15,000). The Elite program is not retroactive; Legacy Live traders keep their original terms.

Q: What platforms/brokers does Tradeify support?
You choose one of three brokers at checkout — all identically priced, no surcharges:
•Tradovate → access to Tradovate (web/desktop, trader.tradovate.com ), NinjaTrader, and TradingView (via Tradovate connection).
•Rithmic → access to Tradesea, Quantower, Sierra Chart (needs paid Sierra subscription), and R|Trader — all on the same Rithmic credentials.
•WealthCharts → WealthCharts platform only (third-party, own login).
You can switch freely among platforms within your broker, but you CANNOT switch brokers (e.g., Tradovate→Rithmic) without buying a new account. TradingView and NinjaTrader require a Tradovate-based account. ProjectX is no longer offered (ProjectX dropped its clients).

Q: Are there data fees?
Level 1 market data is free, provided you sign the Non-Professional Data Agreement on first Tradovate login — otherwise you may incur a $300/month professional data fee and/or delayed data. Level 2 (Depth of Market) and EUREX data are optional paid upgrades, subscribed and billed directly through Tradovate (Account Settings → Subscriptions). Free TradingView accounts have ~5-second delayed data; paid TradingView plans start at $12.95/month (paid to TradingView).

Q: Is hedging allowed?
No. You cannot hold opposing positions (one long, one short ) on the same instrument OR on two products in the same Product Group — in one account or spread across multiple accounts you control. Examples of violations: Long ES + Short ES; Long ES (Acct A) + Short NQ (Acct B) — both Equity Index; Long MES + Short NQ (contract size irrelevant). Product Groups: Equity Index (ES/MES/NQ/MNQ/YM/MYM/RTY/M2K/EMD/NKD/FDAX/FDXM/FDXS/FESX/FSXE/FXXP), Energy (CL/QM/MCL/NG/QG), Metals (GC/QO/MGC/SI/HG/PL/PA), Currencies (6E/M6E/6B/6J/6A/M6A/6C/6S), Interest Rates (FGBL/FGBM/FGBS/FGBX), Grains (ZS/ZL/ZM/ZC/ZW), Livestock (HE/LE/GF), Volatility (FVS — note long equities + long volatility also counts as offsetting). Automated detection breaches an account when opposing positions exist for >10 seconds AND hedge profit exceeds $250 (the 10-second window is only for accidental entries). Consequences: violation status for every account involved, forfeiture of profits from the violation period, payout denial, possible permanent ban. Same-direction positions on multiple accounts ARE allowed (this is how copy trading works).

Q: Is copy trading allowed?
Yes — trading the same instrument in the SAME direction across your accounts is permitted (explicitly described as "how copy trading works" in the hedging article). Opposite directions across accounts are a hedging violation.

Q: Is news trading allowed?
Yes — no rules against trading news events; "free reign" at your own risk (Select explicitly permits Tier 1 news trading). Beware of slippage; never rely on the DLL as a stop during volatility.

Q: Are DCA, martingale, flipping, and scaling allowed?
Yes — no rules against Dollar-Cost Averaging, flipping, or scaling. Martingale is allowed as long as you're not hedging. DCA should be part of a structured strategy ("averaging into oblivion" is discouraged but not banned). All are subject to drawdown/DLL limits.

Q: Are bots/algorithmic trading allowed?
Allowed under conditions: you must be the sole owner of the strategy (provable on request — Tradeify may require a live video of you enabling the code on your PC), it must not be shared with other traders or used across multiple firms, and it must not be a high-frequency trading (HFT) bot. Tradeify scans for similar orders across accounts. HFT bots are prohibited outright.

Q: Is scalping allowed? What is the microscalping rule?
Scalping is allowed, but you must meet BOTH: (1) over 50% of your trades held longer than 10 seconds AND (2) over 50% of your profit from trades held longer than 10 seconds. Failing either means you cannot activate a passed evaluation or request a payout.

Q: What are the trading hours / flat times?
Trading day = CME session, 6:00 PM ET (Sun‒Thu open) to 5:00 PM ET (Mon‒Fri close), with a 5:00‒6:00 PM ET maintenance break. All positions must be closed by 4:45 PM ET every day (holiday short days: by 12:59 PM ET — announced in Discord). No overnight holds across sessions, no weekend holds, no swing trading (except Legacy Live accounts at $100K+ balance). You CAN hold within one session (e.g., 8 PM Monday to 2 PM Tuesday — one continuous session). If you forget, Tradeify auto-flattens at close — no account failure, but possible bad fills. Conflict note: the Common FAQs page says "close before 4:59 PM EST"; the dedicated rules article (canonical) says 4:45 PM ET.

Q: What counts as a "trading day"?
At least one trade placed within one market session: 6:00 PM ET to 5:00 PM ET the next day. Trades at 10 AM and 7 PM on the same calendar day = TWO trading days (different sessions). Rithmic quirk: holiday half-day sessions are recorded at the next full market close, so day credits/payouts may post a session late.

Q: What other practices are prohibited?
•Exploiting platform errors (price display errors, update delays, strategies designed to create errors) — Good Faith Policy; violation → account termination.
•More than one Tradeify account per user (personal + LLC accounts in parallel not allowed).
•More than 5 Sim Funded accounts per user or household.
•Chargebacks (see Resets & Billing).
•Using accounts held by other people at your direction to circumvent rules.

Q: What happens during CME halts or platform outages?
CME halts stop trading on all platforms; Tradeify does not compensate for losses during CME halts. Balance restorations are only granted for confirmed platform-wide incidents (e.g., server outages) — not for normal trading losses, volatility, or exchange-level events.

Touching minimum balance = immediate liquidation. Check in real time: Rithmic → RTrader Pro "Auto Liquidate Threshold Value"; CQG → Tradovate "Drawdown Auto Liq Level" and "Dist Drawdown" columns.

Q: What are the PRO account rules?
1.No trading bots/algos — every trade manually executed; 2) Avoid limit up/down — exit before a CME price limit is reached; if a limit is hit while you hold a position, you lose the PRO account; 3) Trade your account — at least one traded day (≥1 round trip) per calendar week (Sun‒Fri) to keep the account active; contact support for temporary life-circumstance exceptions; 4) No counter positions (all account types); 5) Intraday trailing drawdown (above); 6) No open positions/orders during prohibited news (below).

Q: What is the PRO news rule?
All PRO (and PRO+) accounts must be flat with no open orders one minute before, during, and one minute after prohibited news: FOMC statements (Wed 2:00 PM ET; Fed speakers and FOMC minutes are allowed), Non-Farm Payroll (monthly, Fri 8:30 AM ET), CPI; plus instrument-specific: Crude Oil Inventories (CL), Bond Auctions (ZN 10-yr, ZB 30-yr). Track via forexfactory.com red-folder USD events or TPT's own calendar at https://takeprofittrader.com/user-info/calendar.

Q: Is there an execution limit on PRO?
Yes — the 50 executions rule: no more than 50 executions per day on PRO accounts (an execution = any filled trade regardless of size ). Listed on the official homepage comparison table (PRO only; "None" for Test and PRO+).

Q: Is there a scaling plan or contract limit change in PRO?
No scaling plan on any account — you keep the exact same buying power/contract limits in PRO as in your Test.

Q: Is there a monthly fee for PRO?
No recurring fees. One-time $130 activation fee only (waived for life with NOFEE promo codes).

Q: What paperwork is required to open the PRO account?
After passing: sign the PRO trader contract and the POA (Power of Attorney) form — required for ALL users (even non-NinjaTrader users) because it pre-enables a future PRO+ upgrade with Tradovate (owned by NinjaTrader — their logo appears on the form; you are identified as the "Manager"). An account with an overdue subscription balance cannot move to PRO until paid; if all renewal attempts fail, the account expires and cannot be reactivated.

Q: What is a PRO+ account and what does it cost?
A live-market account with $0 margin — you trade TPT's real capital, orders routed directly to the exchange via Tradovate (not sim, not copy-traded), and you're classified as a professional trader (professional market data). Q: How do I get invited to PRO+?
TPT reviews PRO performance holistically (consistency, risk management, execution patterns, discipline over time — no single threshold) and emails an official invitation. The trader completes onboarding docs; setup takes several days. During the final market-data upgrade step (up to 12 hours), trading on your PRO and Test accounts is temporarily unavailable (you're notified in advance). After upgrade, all trading and withdrawals must be on the PRO+ account only.

Q: What are the PRO+ advantages vs PRO?
•90/10 profit split (trader keeps 90%) vs 80/20 in PRO.

•EOD drawdown (like the Test) instead of PRO's intraday trailing drawdown.
•Live exchange routing. Same day-one/daily payout policy. No daily loss limit (standard PRO+).

Q: How is the PRO+ account structured at opening?
Your PRO account is placed on hold and $5,000 of PRO profit is frozen (must stay while PRO+ is active; anything above $5,000 remains withdrawable at the PRO split). The PRO+ starts at $0 balance with an EOD drawdown equal to your original PRO's starting drawdown (e.g., ex-$50K PRO → PRO+ starts $0 with −$2,000 EOD drawdown). The minimum balance trails up with realized EOD profits and stops at $0. If you lose the PRO+: remaining PRO+ profits plus your share of the frozen $5,000 are withdrawable; a negative PRO+ ending balance is deducted from the frozen $5,000 first, remainder paid at standard PRO split.

Q: What are the PRO+ rules?
1.Eligible instruments during permitted hours only; 2) EOD drawdown — balance incl. open positions must not reach the max EOD drawdown; 3) Weekly trading requirement — ≥1 traded day (≥1 round trip) per calendar week (Sun‒Fri); 4) No counter positions (all account types); 5) Avoid limit up/down — exit before CME price limits; a limit hit while holding = loss of the PRO+ account; 6) News-flat rule — same prohibited-news list as PRO (FOMC/NFP/CPI + CL inventories, bond auctions for ZN/ZB), flat 1 minute before/during/after.

Q: Can I reset a PRO+ account?
No — direct PRO+ resets are not possible. If you lose PRO+, you return by either passing a new evaluation or resetting an existing PRO account, which TPT will then upgrade to PRO+.

Q: What are PRO+ commissions?
Standard broker rates apply on PRO+ (unlike TPT's flat SIM rates) — see NinjaTrader's futures commission schedule (ninjatrader.com/PDF/ninjatrader_futures_commissions.pdf) and tradovate.com/pricing.

Q: What is a PRO+ Development account?
A risk-managed live PRO+ variant that TPT moves traders into after patterns of aggressive sizing, rapid drawdowns, or blown loss limits. Three differences vs standard PRO+: reduced contract sizing, a soft-breach daily loss limit (pauses your day, doesn't fail the account), smaller EOD drawdown:

All PRO+ accounts operate under a unified CME Globex SMP ID at the exchange; CME auto-cancels one side of any would-be self-match under TPT's firm ID (prevents wash trades per CME Rule 534). Profits inside the buffer can only be taken when the account is terminated, at a split determined by account age: ≤60 (trading) days since opening → 50% of the buffer amount; >60 days → 80%.

Rithmic PRO, PRO+, and archived Tradovate accounts remain manually reviewed for now. (2) Wallet → bank: payout requests are manually compliance-reviewed within up to 12 business hours (usually much faster). Wallet withdrawals over $250: free. Withdrawals of $250 or less: $50 fee, deducted automatically. PayPal may add its own fees, deducted from the amount.

Q: What is the four-reason denial list for automated withdrawals?
An automated account-to-wallet request can only be denied for: insufficient funds; open positions/working orders at the moment of request; Tradovate platform maintenance; Tradovate API malfunction. Fix and resubmit immediately — no queue, no waiting period.

Q: Do I pay taxes on payouts?
Yes — TPT is a US company; all PRO users and affiliates must sign a tax form before the first payout (via provider ComplyExchange): W-9 for US persons/companies, W-8BEN for non-US. The built-in cash hub: PRO/PRO+ profits go account → wallet → payout. Wallet funds can also pay for anything at TPT (new subscriptions, resets) — but only if the wallet covers the entire cost (no partial/split payments yet). Withdrawals from the wallet require MFA if enabled.

Rithmic accounts only: Level 2 free for one exchange, $15/month per additional exchange (contact Live Chat to add). Not offered on CQG at this time. Bookmap requires L2 enabled plus a Bookmap Global/Global Plus plan.

CQG: yes, two platforms simultaneously on Test/PRO (may be affected on PRO+). Rithmic: no two simultaneous connections, except the supported RTrader Pro + NinjaTrader plug-in mode ("Allow Plugins" + "Plug-in mode for market data").

7. Prohibited Practices & Compliance
Sources: https://takeprofittraderhelp.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/34431153546397 (UTP ), /articles/34431223270557 (Independent Trade Execution), /articles/34431176505245 (Trade Copier Policy), /articles/30331694826909 (Rule 6), /articles/36569493361693 (Sustainable Trading Policy), /articles/31253734288797 (CME rules), /articles/22447557656477 (Restricted Countries), blog: trade-surveillance-powered-by-eventus.

Q: Is automated/bot trading allowed?
No. No automated trading systems, bots, or algorithmic execution tools on any account type; all trades must be manually executed by the trader.

Q: Are trade copiers allowed?
Yes — only across accounts you solely own and control. Approved copiers: Tradesyncer, TradeCopia, Affordable Indicators, Replikanto Flowbot (Compliance Edition only), and platform-native copier tools (Tradovate, NinjaTrader, MotiveWave, Quantower, etc.). Unapproved/modified/non-compliance copiers = enforcement action. Copying between different users/identities, pass/payout services, and copier-created opposite positions are prohibited — copier trades count as your own for all rules (a copier-caused counter position is still a Rule 6 violation).

Q: Is hedging allowed?
No. Counter positions — opposite directions in the same or closely related products (e.g., ES↔MES, NQ↔MNQ, YM↔MYM; list non-exhaustive) across any accounts under the same beneficial control — are prohibited on Test, PRO, and PRO+. Detection is automated near-real-time; consequences: automatic liquidation of affected accounts, profit forfeiture, possible bans. You receive an email with a downloadable Counter-Positions Report (timestamps, products, actions, exposure, correlation classification). Two household members may trade separately, but mirror/coordinated or offsetting trades are banned.

Q: Is copy trading between traders / group trading allowed?
No. The Independent Trade Execution Policy prohibits coordinated timing/pricing with other users, real-time mirroring, synchronized execution across identities, coordinated opposing positions to neutralize risk, and multi-identity account structuring where some accounts' failure boosts others. Monitoring uses trade-timing correlation, strategy similarity, sizing patterns, execution clustering, and device/infrastructure clustering (no single signal like shared IP is a violation alone). Syncing your OWN accounts is fine (long-only same-direction), never opposing.

Q: Is news trading prohibited?
Test: allowed. PRO/PRO+: must be flat (no positions or working orders) 1 minute before, during, and 1 minute after FOMC statements (Wed 2 PM ET), NFP (Fri 8:30 AM ET monthly), CPI; plus Crude Oil Inventories for CL and Bond Auctions for ZN/ZB.

Q: What is the Sustainable Trading Policy?
"Trade your TPT account like your own brokerage account." Aggressive styles are allowed but draw closer review, especially live. Red-flag patterns: max position size on most trades, repeatedly blowing loss limits, exploiting sim-specific fill inefficiencies, account churning, and concentrated max-size bets at predictable moments (open, economic releases). A material PRO-vs-PRO+ performance gap triggers review; TPT may modify parameters or end the funding relationship at its discretion, with or without notice, for simulation-only strategies.

Q: What CME rules does TPT enforce?
CME-aligned conduct standards, notably Rule 531 (no trading against customer orders), 533 (simultaneous buy/sell orders — 5-second exposure requirement), 534 (wash trades prohibited), 539 (pre-execution communications), 575 (disruptive practices — spoofing/layering/quote stuffing). Violations can mean immediate termination and referral to CME Market Regulation/CFTC. TPT's trade surveillance is powered by Eventus (per official blog).

Q: What happens at market limit up/down?
You must exit all positions before a price limit is reached (CME price limits page linked in rules). If a limit is hit while you hold a position, you lose the PRO/PRO+ account (TPT must hedge against traders holding near limits).

Monthly subscription per Test account, charged on the same calendar day/time as the original purchase. Dashboard → Journey to Profit → X icon next to the subscription or "Cancel Subscription" in account details. Irreversible once confirmed; access continues to the end of the paid billing period; if you haven't hit the target by cycle end, the test is unsuccessful.

Q: Does a reset change my renewal date?
No — Test and PRO resets never change the subscription renewal date. Monthly renewal auto-resets a disabled account for free; active accounts aren't touched.

Q: What is the refund policy?
⚠ No general refund policy is published in the knowledge base. At checkout you agree to a "Dispute Resolution and the Refund Policy" document (in the order form terms). The only refund mechanics documented publicly are promo-based: e.g., the NOFEE40/NOFEE100 "100% Refunds" promos refund your first month's test fee in that account's first withdrawal (resets excluded). Optional authenticator-app MFA (up to 10 methods, recovery codes shown once). When enabled it gates login, withdrawals, the Document Hub, and MFA management; re-prompted for critical actions after 10 minutes. Lost access → KYC-based recovery flow.

Hold positions in one direction only at any time. Key Concepts Across All Firms
Account Types
•Evaluation/Challenge/Test: Initial phase where traders prove profitability
•Funded/Performance Account: Granted after passing evaluation; trader keeps percentage of profits
•Live Trading: Real capital accounts (invitation-only at most firms)
Drawdown Types
•End-of-Day (EOD) Trailing: Recalculates at market close, trails highest EOD balance
•Intraday Trailing: Real-time trailing based on peak balance including unrealized gains
•Static: Fixed maximum loss from starting balance
Risk Management
•Daily Loss Limit (DLL): Maximum loss per trading day (soft breach - pauses trading)
•Consistency Rule: Prevents making all profit in a single lucky trade
•Maximum Drawdown: Hard breach - fails the account permanently
Payouts
•Profit Split: Percentage trader keeps (typically 80-90%)
•Payout Frequency: Daily, weekly, or after specific milestones
•Payout Speed: Minutes to days depending on firm
Common User Questions & Answers

Q: Which firm has the fastest payouts?
A: Lucid Trading averages 15 minutes. My Funded Futures offers 24-hour payouts. FundedNext processes within 24 hours. Check specific firm documentation for current speeds.

Q: What's the cheapest way to get started?
A: Lucid Trading ($60), Funding Predicts ($125 for $25K), and Tradeify ($99 for Growth 25K) offer low entry costs. Compare against profit splits and payout speeds.

Q: Can I hold multiple accounts?
A: Most firms allow 5-20 funded accounts per household. Check specific firm limits in their documentation.

Q: What's the difference between trailing and static drawdown?
A: Trailing drawdown resets as your account grows; static stays fixed from your starting balance. Most traders prefer trailing.

Q: How long does it take to get funded?
A: Lucid Trading: 2 days. Tradeify Growth: 1 day. Funding Predicts: varies. Take Profit Trader: 5+ trading days. Check firm-specific timelines.

QUICK REFERENCE GUIDE
Key Terminology
Evaluation/Challenge: Testing phase where traders must reach profit targets without 
hitting loss limits to qualify for funded accounts.
Drawdown (Trailing vs. Static): Trailing drawdown moves with account balance; static 
remains fixed from starting balance.
Daily Loss Limit: Maximum amount a trader can lose in a single trading day.
Profit Split: Percentage of profits the trader keeps (e.g., 80%, 90%).
Consistency Rule: Requirement that traders don't make all profits in a single lucky trade; 
must demonstrate consistent performance.
Straight-to-Funded: Account option that skips evaluation and provides immediate funding.
Payout Window: Specific time period during which traders can request payouts.
EOD (End of Day): Calculations performed at the end of each trading day.
Common Questions Answered

Q: Do I need trading experience?
A: Most firms accept traders without prior experience. Evaluation programs are designed to 
teach discipline and risk management.

Q: What's the difference between sim and live funded accounts?
A: Sim accounts use simulated capital for trading; live accounts use real firm capital. 
Different rules may apply to each.

Q: Can I trade news events?
A: Most firms have specific news trading policies. Some allow it with restrictions; others 
prohibit it entirely. Check individual firm policies.

Q: How quickly can I get paid?
A: Payout times vary from 1 minute (My Funded Futures Rapid) to 5 days (Topstep). Most 
firms process within 24-48 hours.

Q: What strategies are prohibited?
A: Common prohibitions include scalping, hedging, high-frequency trading, and strategies 
that exploit platform mechanics. Specific rules vary by firm.

Q: Can I use automated trading (bots/EAs)?
A: Policies vary. Some firms allow EAs with restrictions; others prohibit them entirely. Verify 
with your chosen firm.

Q: Which firm has the highest profit split?
A: Lucid Trading, Topstep, and My Funded Futures all offer 90% profit split. Alpha Futures 
also offers 90%. FundedNext offers 80%+ depending on performance.

Q: Which firm has the fastest payouts?
A: My Funded Futures offers the fastest payouts (as quick as 1 minute on Rapid plan). Lucid 
Trading averages 15 minutes. FundedNext averages 40 hours. Topstep takes 3-5 days.

Q: What is the maximum withdrawal amount?
A: Alpha Futures Advanced Accounts offer industry-leading $15,000 maximum withdrawal. 
Other firms vary from $1,000-$3,000 depending on account type and size.

Overview
Alpha Futures is a Netherlands-based prop trading firm established in 2024. The firm offers 
monthly subscription-based evaluation accounts with a straightforward payout policy. 
Alpha Futures emphasizes transparency and simplicity in their trading rules and payout 
structure.

Account Types
The Standard Account is an entry-level evaluation account with standard parameters and 
rules. The Advanced Account is a premium evaluation account with higher capital 
allocation and enhanced features. Minimum withdrawal is $1,000 with industry-leading 
maximum withdrawal of $15,000. The Zero Account is an evaluation account with lower 
starting capital that includes a 40% consistency rule requirement for withdrawals. 
Withdrawal minimums are $200 with maximums of $1,000-$2,500 depending on account 
size. The Direct Account skips the evaluation phase and requires reaching withdrawal profit 
targets and adhering to a 20% consistency rule. Minimum withdrawal is $500. Alpha Prime 
is an exclusive program for advanced traders transitioning to higher levels of trading.

Getting Started Process
KYC (Know Your Customer ) must be completed in the Dashboard Profile section. It is 
recommended to complete this during or before evaluation since the compliance team 
needs manual approval. Follow Veriff prompts and upload required documents. Sign the 
contract in the dashboard between trader and Alpha Futures. There is a 30-day window to 
sign after passing evaluation; the contract expires if not signed within 30 days. Pay the 
activation fee for Advanced Accounts (accounts purchased after July 8, 2026 do not require 
activation fees). The qualified account is received within 24 hours after all steps are 
completed.
Trading Rules & Parameters
The Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) uses EOD (end of day) trailing calculation on all accounts 
with no intraday trailing drawdown. It is calculated from account balance high at end of 
each trading day, not intraday equity high. The MLL stops trailing at account starting 
balance. Example: A $50K account starts with $48,000 MLL (-$2,000). If the account reaches 
$50,500 (+$500), MLL becomes $48,500. If the account drops back to $50,000, MLL stays at 
$48,500. Once MLL reaches the initial starting balance, it won't continue to trail. Hitting MLL 
results in account liquidation; no further orders execute. On evaluation accounts, the 
account is no longer eligible to become qualified; traders must purchase a reset or wait for 
monthly rebill. On qualified accounts, the account is breached and closed.
Daily Loss Guard sets a maximum daily loss limit that stops trading for that day once hit. 
The Consistency Rule requires 40% consistency on Zero Accounts and 20% consistency on 
Direct Accounts for withdrawal eligibility, with no consistency rule on Advanced Accounts. 
Prohibited Trading Practices include specific strategies and practices explicitly prohibited, 
market manipulation and account abuse, and scalping restrictions. Copy trading has 
specific rules and cannot directly copy other traders' accounts. News Trading Policy 
provides specific guidelines for trading around economic news releases with restrictions on 
trading during certain news events and high-impact economic data releases. Inactivity Rule 
applies to accounts if no trading occurs for extended periods. Scaling Plan allows ability to 
scale account size based on performance. Price Limit Trading has restrictions on price limit 
orders with specific parameters.
Account Overviews by Type
The Standard Account Overview is an entry-level evaluation with standard parameters 
designed for traders new to Alpha Futures. The Advanced Account Overview is a premium 
evaluation account with higher capital allocation, no consistency rule required, minimum 
withdrawal of $1,000, maximum withdrawal of $15,000 (industry-leading), and no winning 
day requirement for withdrawals. The Zero Account Overview is a lower starting capital 
option with 40% consistency rule required for withdrawals, withdrawal minimums of $200, 
withdrawal maximums of $1,000-$2,500 depending on account size, and winning day 
requirement of 5 winning trading days of $200+ profit between withdrawals. The Direct 
Account Overview is a straight-to-funded account (skips evaluation) with 20% consistency 
rule required, withdrawal profit targets required (25K: 1st $1,500/2nd+ $1,000 max $1,000; 
50K: 1st $3,000/2nd+ $2,000 max $2,000; 100K: 1st $6,000/2nd+ $4,000 max $2,500; 150K: 
1st $9,000/2nd+ $6,000 max $3,000), minimum withdrawal of $500, and no winning day 
requirement.

Payout Information
Traders can withdraw up to 4 times per month by requesting every 5 winning trading days 
of $200+ profit. Winning trading days do not need to be consecutive. Traders can request up 
to 50% of account profit per withdrawal (up to withdrawal limit) with remaining balance 
staying on account for drawdown or future withdrawals. All withdrawal requests are the 
amount removed from trading account with traders receiving 90% of the withdrawal 
request amount.
Advanced Qualified Accounts have minimum withdrawal of $1,000, maximum withdrawal 
of $15,000 (all account sizes), no consistency rule required, and no winning day 
requirement. Zero Qualified Accounts have minimum withdrawal of $200, 25K account 
maximum of $1,000, 50K account maximum of $1,500, 100K account maximum of $2,500, 
and 40% consistency rule required. Direct Qualified Accounts have minimum withdrawal of 
$500, withdrawal profit targets required (as specified above), 20% consistency rule 
required, and no winning day requirement.
Payout Methods include multiple payment options, crypto payments accepted, and third-
party payments available. Maximum Withdrawal Request varies by account type and size 
with Advanced accounts at $15,000 maximum (industry-leading), Zero accounts at 
$1,000-$2,500, and Direct accounts at $1,000-$3,000. The Affiliate Program offers affiliate 
partnership opportunities with available commission structure. The Alpha Creator Program 
is a special program for content creators and influencers.

Monthly Subscription Information
Monthly Subscription uses a monthly evaluation subscription model with monthly 
subscription resets. Activation fee may apply (not required for accounts purchased after 
July 8, 2026). Reset option allows traders who hit maximum loss limit to try again. Level 2 
and EUREX Data packages are available with Level 2 market data option and EUREX trading 
data available.

Trading Platforms Supported
Supported platforms include Deepchart, Quantower, WealthCharts, AlphaTrader, 
NinjaTrader, TradingView, and additional platforms may be supported.

Geographic Restrictions
Certain countries have trading restrictions. Check help center for complete list of restricted 
countries. KYC verification is required for all traders.
Key Differences from Other Firms
Alpha Futures distinguishes itself through straightforward payout policy with no hidden 
denials (follow rules and get paid), industry-leading maximum withdrawal of $15,000 on 
Advanced Accounts, monthly subscription model different from one-time payment firms, 
EOD trailing MLL with no intraday drawdown calculations, Direct Accounts providing 
straight-to-funded option, flexible withdrawal schedule of up to 4 times per month, and 
competitive 90% profit split.
